functions.name: resolveWorkbenchEvaluationWidth
params:
{
  chatPanelDragging,
  chatPanelMaximized,
  chatVisible,
  chatWidth,
  mainContentWidth,
  measuredWorkbenchWidth,
}

callGraph.callee:
value
      .filter(
        (item): item is { type: string; text: string } =>
          typeof item === "object" &&
          item !== null &&
          (item as Record<string, unknown>).type === "text" &&
          typeof (item as Record<string, unknown>).text === "string"
      )
      .map
